name: Zillertaler Höhenweg – Etappenwanderung
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Zillertaler Höhenweg is one of the most beautiful long-distance hikes in the Alps. Over five day stages, you traverse the Zillertaler Alps from east to west, staying in charming mountain huts and enjoying breathtaking alpine twilight each evening. Pack transport and hut booking are included in the service package.
